# Copilot Instructions

This file is intentionally short. The canonical agent operating manual lives at
the repository root in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) so it's shared across
GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other agents.

**Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first.** Detailed convention docs are under
[`docs/agent-conventions/`](../docs/agent-conventions/) — load them on demand,
not eagerly.
